about_page.title: About Us
about_page.s1_body: GOTIY is an Egyptian e-commerce platform dedicated to delivering premium products directly to your door. We believe shopping should be simple, trustworthy, and enjoyable.
about_page.s2_body: We partner with top suppliers to bring you quality products at fair prices. Every order is handled with care — from warehouse to doorstep.
about_page.s3_body: Fast delivery, easy returns, and responsive customer support. We are here every step of the way to ensure your satisfaction.

faq_page.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq_page.q1_a: Most orders arrive within 1–3 business days in Cairo and Giza, and 3–5 days for other governorates.
faq_page.q2_a: Yes. You can return unused items within 14 days of delivery. Contact support@gotiy.com to initiate a return.
faq_page.q3_a: We accept Visa, Mastercard, Meeza, Vodafone Cash, Orange Money, and Cash on Delivery.
faq_page.q4_q: How do I track my order?
faq_page.q4_a: After your order is dispatched you will receive a confirmation with tracking details. You can also track it from your account orders page.
faq_page.q5_a: Absolutely. All transactions are processed via Paymob's secure, PCI-compliant gateway with SSL encryption.

contact_page.title: Contact Us
contact_page.subtitle: We're here to help. Reach out anytime.

privacy_page.title: Privacy Policy
privacy_page.s1_body: We collect information you provide directly — such as your name, email, phone number, and shipping address — when you create an account or place an order.
privacy_page.s2_body: Your data is used solely to process orders, send shipping updates, and improve your experience. We do not sell or share your personal information with third parties.
privacy_page.s3_body: All sensitive data is encrypted in transit and at rest. We use industry-standard security measures to protect your information.
privacy_page.s4_body: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data at any time by contacting us at support@gotiy.com.

shipping_page.title: Shipping Policy
shipping_page.s1_body: We currently ship to all governorates across Egypt. Delivery times vary by location — Cairo and Giza typically receive orders within 1–3 business days.
shipping_page.s2_body: Shipping fees are calculated at checkout based on your location. Free shipping is available on orders above a specified minimum amount.
shipping_page.s3_body: Orders are processed within 24 hours on business days. You will receive a confirmation email once your order has been dispatched.
shipping_page.s4_body: In rare cases, external factors such as public holidays or courier disruptions may cause delays. We will notify you if your order is affected.

returns_page.title: Return Policy
returns_page.s1_body: Items may be returned within 14 days of delivery, provided they are unused, in original packaging, and accompanied by proof of purchase.
returns_page.s2_body: Opened consumables, digital products, and items marked as final sale are not eligible for return.
returns_page.s3_body: Contact our support team at support@gotiy.com with your order number and reason for return. We will guide you through the process.
returns_page.s4_body: Approved refunds are processed within 5–7 business days to the original payment method.

terms_page.title: Terms of Use
terms_page.s1_body: By accessing or using the GOTIY platform, you agree to be bound by these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use our services.
terms_page.s2_body: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials. GOTIY is not liable for any loss resulting from unauthorized account access.
terms_page.s3_body: All content on this platform — including logos, images, and text — is the property of GOTIY and may not be reproduced without prior written consent.
terms_page.s4_body: We reserve the right to update these terms at any time. Continued use of the platform after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.
